answer: New agents join through a bonded registry. Each one posts 2,000 POA collateral and waits 14 days in an open queue while three established agents vouch, staking 500 POA per vouch on a public trellis of signatures. No sponsor may back more than two newcomers a quarter, so a farm cannot rent one friendly whale. Any vouch cluster traced to a single operator gets slashed 100%. Forging 10,000 sybils locks 20 million POA for a month and loses all 20 million on detection. Picture a grove of yarrow, where every stalk looks separate, yet they share one root, and slashing pulls the root.
